turns.replyText:
How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Great question! Here's how to get the best results with your Mesa Loop 30oz: 💧

Using It:

Twist and lock the straw into the lid — it clicks in securely so you don't have to tilt the bottle
Click the button up/down to lock or unlock the covered lid (this keeps it leak-proof!)
Use the airflow relief valve — that large opening enhances your straw drinking experience and makes sipping effortless
The loop handle folds down for easy one-finger carrying

Keeping It Fresh:

Top rack dishwasher safe — both bottle and lid
Disassemble the lid before cleaning — remove the silicone plug and straw
Place the straw upright in the dishwasher so water flows through it during the wash cycle
Air dry thoroughly before storing to keep everything fresh
Don't microwave

Pro tip: The contoured straw has a wider opening designed for easier sipping, and the silicone base keeps it quiet when you set it down!
